The Glasgow Independent and Meade County school sites draw their board pages by script; the Bardstown Independent board page does not list Virginia Roby 'Ginny' Holland. Scott Sharp and Walker Wood Thomas are sitting legislators; no campaign website of their own was found. Lianna Simpson Nguyen: Boone County Democrats list her for Commissioner District 3 while the November list says District 2 (already noted in ballot/lean/ky_endorsements.json); LINK nky, citing the Registry of Election Finance, says the 2nd district. On radcliff.org the council list carries home addresses beside each name: only the name and the office were read into this file.
